en.title: Biggest PPPoker Tournament — Nuts PPPoker
en.description: The biggest PPPoker tournament: record prize pool, how the event played out, and how to qualify for the next major Nuts club events.
en.bodyHtml:
This Sunday, September 14 at 18:00 MSK, the BIG MAIN EVENT runs with a $80,000 guarantee!

Don’t miss your chance at a truly big score and make your mark in the largest NUTS tournament.
